faqs.question: What Modules Are Covered in Oracle APEX Training?
faqs.answer: Our Oracle APEX program covers the complete future-ready stack: Application Builder, SQL Workshop, Object Browser, SQL Commands, Interactive Grids, Dynamic Actions, Shared Components, APEX Themes, Redwood UI, REST APIs (ORDS), Automations, Security, and Packaging & Deployment. You also learn Fusion-ERP integrations, AI-powered APEX components, and OCI-based deployment, matching 2026 market expectations.

faqs.question: What Is the Course Schedule?
faqs.answer: Live classes run Monday to Saturday, 1 hour per day, ensuring continuous learning and hands-on APEX practice aligned with modern enterprise workflows.

faqs.question: Are Weekend Batches Available?
faqs.answer: No weekend-only batches are available. Weekday sessions ensure smoother progression and better consistency for advanced APEX learning.

faqs.question: Do You Offer Self-Paced Learning?
faqs.answer: Yes, self-paced recorded APEX sessions are available. However, real-time doubt solving is exclusive to live batches.

faqs.question: Do You Provide Internship Opportunities?
faqs.answer: Yes. Based on your performance, you may qualify for internships involving AI-enabled APEX apps, Fusion integrations, and OCI-based low-code projects.

faqs.question: Can I Download the Training Videos?
faqs.answer: No, downloads are restricted. You get 2-year portal access to all recordings.

faqs.question: Can I Take Only One Module?
faqs.answer: No. APEX is a full-stack low-code platform, so modules like Interactive Grids, REST APIs, Dynamic Actions, and Security must be learned together.

faqs.question: Do You Provide Resume Preparation Support?
faqs.answer: Yes. We help you build a resume tailored for roles like Low-Code Developer, APEX Developer, APEX Automation Engineer, and Fusion Extension Specialist (high-demand roles for 2026+).

faqs.question: Is a Laptop or Desktop Required?
faqs.answer: Yes. A system is required to access the APEX workspace, SQL Workshop, REST integrations, and to perform practical exercises.

faqs.question: Are There Any Prerequisites?
faqs.answer: Basic SQL is required. PL/SQL, cloud basics, and web concepts help but are not mandatory. The training starts from fundamentals and moves toward advanced low-code development.

faqs.question: Do You Teach From Basics?
faqs.answer: Yes. We begin with APEX essentials, SQL Workshop, and Database fundamentals, then move to 2026-focused topics like Redwood UI, REST APIs, Automations, AI-powered features, and OCI deployment.

faqs.question: Do You Provide Job Placement Assistance?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer placement guidance, mock interviews, resume building, and access to openings in APEX, ERP, and low-code roles across cloud-native organizations.

faqs.question: Do You Provide Certification Support?
faqs.answer: Yes. We help you prepare for relevant certifications in Oracle APEX, Oracle Database, ORDS, and low-code development.

faqs.question: Do You Provide Training Recordings and Material?
faqs.answer: Yes. You’ll receive recordings and detailed documentation covering APEX components, Redwood UI steps, REST service setup, and real-time use cases.

faqs.question: Do You Provide Interview Preparation?
faqs.answer: Yes. We share frequently asked interview questions for APEX, SQL, PL/SQL, REST APIs, and low-code app development — aligned with future hiring trends.

faqs.question: Is Workspace Access Provided?
faqs.answer: Yes. You get access to an Oracle APEX workspace hosted on Oracle Autonomous Database or OCI. No installation required.

faqs.question: Can I Retake This Course?
faqs.answer: Yes. You get 1-year live batch access to revisit classes and strengthen your APEX skills.

faqs.question: Will I Get a Course Completion Certificate?
faqs.answer: Yes. You receive an official certificate after completing the training and project assessments.

faqs.question: Is Coding Knowledge Required?
faqs.answer: Basic SQL is enough. APEX is designed for both coders and non-coders, and we guide you through all advanced features step-by-step.

faqs.question: Do You Provide One-on-One Training?
faqs.answer: Yes. Personalized APEX mentoring is available for those who prefer individual sessions (higher pricing applies).
